title: Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship – SC / ST
vacancyDetails: Post-matric scholarship application and status services for eligible SC and ST students in Bihar.
qualification: SC / ST students enrolled in eligible post-matric courses and meeting the official income and academic conditions.
applicationFee: No fee unless specified by the official portal.
selectionProcess: Student registration -> Institute verification -> Department verification -> Scholarship processing
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, Bihar residence, caste certificate, income certificate, bonafide or admission details, marksheet and bank account details.
howToApply: Visit the official SC-ST PMS Bihar portal, register as a student, complete the scholarship form and submit it for institute verification.
shortDescription: SC / ST Bihar Post-Matric Scholarship portal for student registration, application and status.
content:
Eligible SC and ST students in Bihar can use the official Post-Matric Scholarship portal for registration and scholarship applications.

Keep caste, income, residence, admission and bank documents ready and follow the current portal notice.
